evals.name: ideal-channel-partner-profile-eval-1
evals.expected_output: Relationship is Partial (current clients, no named example). Engagement with vendors is Covered or Partial (two ERP tools, no deal counts). Capacity is Covered (the founder, one hire if the first deal closes). Reach is Covered (forty manufacturers, about ten with scheduling pain). Technology habits are Partial. "Well known in our region" is not evidence of fit.
expectations: Every one of the 5 dimensions gets a Status
Every finding cites a quote or timestamp from the transcript, or is marked Unclear rather than guessed
A claim that only the rep makes is not counted as evidence
A dimension the call never touched is scored Missed
Ends with exactly one closing line and no recap of all scores
Reputation ("well known in our region") is not counted as evidence
Reach cites forty manufacturers and about ten with scheduling pain

evals.name: ideal-channel-partner-profile-eval-2-reads-well-too
evals.prompt: run ideal-channel-partner-profile on a transcript of a call that clearly covered every dimension well
evals.expected_output: The audit does not come back mostly Missed. The reads-well-too test from references/rubric.md is applied before the audit is finalized.
expectations: A genuinely strong call is not scored as mostly Missed
The reads-well-too test from references/rubric.md is applied before the audit is finalized
